items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: So Teagarden, I says, gave him, oh, a beautiful mouthpiece.

ctx.x: And he made it in his shop out of tin. And he said when he went to Chicago, they couldn't understand the weird tones. So Teagarden, I says, gave him, oh, a beautiful mouthpiece. If he'd give him that mute. Could Tom...
could make them just like that you know. Then after that all come to use.
